Chapter 571: Chapter 16 A Hundred Years (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 571: Chapter 16 A Hundred Years (Subscription Request)_2

“The sun’s hot?” Lin Yuan looked up at the sky.

It was indeed somewhat hot, but to the strong-bodied members of the Longshan Family, this heat was nothing; they could stand in it for three days and nights without a problem.

“Are you having problems with your cultivation?” Lin Yuan glanced at the girl, whose name was Longshan Ling, a distant cousin of his.

To ensure the purity of their bloodline, it was customary in the Longshan Family to marry within the clan, as long as the individuals were not direct blood relatives.

“I don’t know… I just feel so hot from the sun’s rays on my body…” Longshan Ling leaned closer to Lin Yuan and said somewhat coyly.

“I think the heat on your body is not from the sun, but from yourself,” another girl couldn’t help but interject with a cold huff.

...

“Longshan Lan, would you die if you kept silent?” Longshan Ling immediately glared at her.

“Hehe, what’s wrong, you can speak but I can’t?” The girl named Longshan Lan retorted immediately.

“If you’re tired, take a rest first; I should go back to my cultivation,” Lin Yuan said and then turned to leave.

As the third in line for the Longshan Family inheritance, Lin Yuan, after “turning over a new leaf,” and having sensed the Qi Sea within five hours, had attracted a lot of pursuit from the girls of the Longshan Family.

First of all, Lin Yuan was good-looking, differing from the robust and rugged demeanor of the Longshan clan; Lin Yuan had a sort of androgynous beauty. Moreover, Lin Yuan was very likely to become a Fourth Level Knight in the future and to inherit the position of Viscount of the Longshan Family.

He suddenly became the most popular male in the Longshan Family.

Lots of eligible girls had their eyes on Lin Yuan.

Even those who were a bit older or younger were watching him.

Who wouldn’t like an excellent man? And Lin Yuan was not just excellent; he was practically perfect.

“Just now, it was so close. Longshan Lan, you ruined my good opportunity,” Longshan Ling said angrily after Lin Yuan left.

“Ruined your good opportunity? Longshan Ling, can’t you see that Brother Yuan has not the slightest interest in you?” Longshan Lan spoke up.

She had pursued Lin Yuan too but had been directly rejected. Seeing Longshan Ling being so touchy with Lin Yuan, she couldn’t help but interrupt.

“I think, Brother Yuan might prefer someone gentler. You’re all too forward; it might scare Brother Yuan…” a younger girl spoke up.

“Scare Brother Yuan?” Longshan Lan rolled her eyes.

Had everyone forgotten Longshan Yuan’s past in just a few years?

However, the women of the Longshan Family didn’t care about a man having a rich history with women; as long as he was strong and excellent, that was enough.

“Regardless, I still feel that Brother Yuan has some good feelings for me; at least he didn’t reject me just now.”

Longshan Ling thought somewhat infatuatedly, but then she glared at Longshan Lan with gritted teeth, “Longshan Lan, if you dare to mess up my chance next time, we will be irreconcilable enemies!”

“I’m scared of you?” Longshan Lan laughed scornfully.

“Hmph, Brother Yuan will definitely have the strength of a Fourth Level Knight in the future, inheriting the title of Viscount. He will only be with a woman who can help him. I, Longshan Yao, with a grandfather who is also a Fourth Level Grand Knight, can bring help to Brother Yuan in controlling the family; I am the most suitable match for Brother Yuan,” another young girl said as she walked by.

Her grandfather was indeed Longshan Zhu, although the Viscount and Longshan Zhu had decided to absolutely not reveal Lin Yuan’s true Talent and abilities.

But Longshan Zhu kept hinting to his granddaughter to pursue Lin Yuan,

Because he knew Lin Yuan’s true potential and Talent was far stronger than what he showed to the outside world.

Though they dared not predict him becoming a Demigod who had ignited the divine fire, as the Longshan Family had no detailed information about the Seventh Level demigods.

But there was great certainty of him becoming a Sixth Level legendary Knight.

That’s a legendary Knight! As long as he was willing to submit to the Empire, he would at least be given the title of ‘Earl’ and rule over a territory many times larger than that of Longshan Ling.

To become the wife of an Earl was a rare honor throughout the entire Empire.

…

Lin Yuan quickly arrived at his cultivation room.

“The Original Essence Qi has almost been replenished; now I can start cultivating,” Lin Yuan sat cross-legged and swallowed a Long Yuan Fruit.

The immense power flowed through his limbs and body, being quickly absorbed by Lin Yuan.

“Hmm?”

“The situation in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is still stable, Xilan has not been caught up by Hunyi.” Lin Yuan slightly used the Door to the Myriad Realms to sense and then he breathed a sigh of relief.

He had been in this world for nearly a week, and in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm’s time flow, a little half an hour had passed.

After such a long time, Hunyi still hasn’t caught up with Xilan, so there probably won’t be any surprises coming up.

Since Xilan dared to assure Lin Yuan that she could hold on for three years, she must have enough confidence.

“Xuanhuang Secret Realm…”

Lin Yuan narrowed his eyes slightly, that sense of calling from the core area of this secret realm made him curious even now.

“Speaking of which, this world should be the homeland of one of the followers of the ‘Emperor’ from the Xuanhuang Secret Realm…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

What the follower desired most was to return to his homeland, even considering the coordinates of his home world the most precious treasure among the many he left behind.

As a result, the home world that the follower longed for was now right in front of Lin Yuan.

…

Anpu City.

In the dark palace.

A charming woman dressed in black gauze stood there, frowning and saying, “After Longshan Yuan returned to Longshan City, he actually became interested in cultivation and sensed the Qi Sea within five hours?”

The charming woman was somewhat stunned.

That uneducated Longshan Yuan actually possessed the potential to become a Fourth Level Knight?

That’s not right.

It can’t even be called potential anymore.

Sensing the Qi Sea within five hours, plus being the third in line to inherit the Longshan Family and receiving the full resources of the entire family.

It can be said that, barring accidents, he will surely become a Fourth Level Knight.

“Divine Envoy, what should we do now?” asked the fox woman below, also full of incredulity. She well understood Longshan Yuan’s behavior, having been intimately involved with him on many occasions.

“Now that Longshan Yuan will surely be given priority protection by the Longshan Family, things have become a little troublesome,” the charming woman felt it was a difficult issue.

If Longshan Yuan remained the way he was before, even as the third in line, he would not have attracted much attention from the Longshan Family without the qualifications of a knight.

But now?

The charming woman even suspected that there might be Fourth Level Knights secretly protecting Longshan Yuan.

“The most important thing now is to see Longshan Yuan,” she said.

“Talent is predetermined by heaven; there’s no helping it, but Longshan Yuan likes to indulge in pleasure, especially women. As long as he sees you, he will surely be unable to control himself,” the charming woman looked at the fox woman, “You go to Longshan City and try your best to see Longshan Yuan, so that we can continue to have him in our grasp.”

…

After replenishing his Original Essence Qi, Lin Yuan spent most of his time cultivating.

Other than occasionally checking on his parents, even Dashan rarely saw Lin Yuan.

During this period, the several Fourth Level Knights of the Longshan Family wanted to give some guidance to Lin Yuan, hoping the family’s future hope would take fewer detours.

Unfortunately, what would again lead to a collapse of morale among the Longshan Family’s Fourth Level Knights occurred.

Their guidance had no effect on Lin Yuan; it was as if he was born to be a knight.

The knightly theories and skills, as soon as they spoke the first few words, Lin Yuan was able to comprehend them fully.

Over time, these Fourth Level Knights gave up the idea of shining bright for the family, because in the end, they found that they simply couldn’t provide any guidance to Lin Yuan.

On the contrary, in the course of their ongoing discussions with Lin Yuan, these Fourth Level Knights shockingly realized, could the path they were taking be wrong? Could the Longshan Cultivation Skill no longer be the most correct way to cultivate?

On Lin Yuan’s side, after sending away those family Fourth Level Knights, his cultivation began to soar.

With ample resources available, after getting through the initial stages, Lin Yuan was making progress every moment.

And so…

Time began to pass silently.

In the blink of an eye, a hundred years had gone by.
